title: The Erosion of the Self
text: “Ugh… How am I supposed to stop that thing?!”
It’d be a real hassle if we had to fight even more of the Four Spirits. If we can stop it here, we should. I’d like to think we still have time if we kill it.
“Gaelion will clean up the Dragon Emperor’s mess!”
Rival pokes his head out from my Father’s Shooting Star Shield and unleashes a breath attack on the dragon. Though, it doesn’t seem to be very effective.
“Why! Why are they so strong?!”
“You of all people should know how strong the Heroes are—you’re the one who possesses the power of past Dragon Emperors!”
“I won’t accept that! The Heroes of the past must be weaker than us! Yes, Takt is the strongest of all.”
“Naofumi, that Dragon Emperor doesn’t possess a single fragment of memory from the Heroes who fought in past eras!”
Hearing his rival’s words, my Father seems to understand and nods.

“It… seems so. Judging by what’s happened so far, he probably doesn’t possess any actual memories of seeing the Four Sacred Heroes from the past. That’s why he couldn’t explain the true strength of the Four Sacred Heroes to Takt.”
“That’s it!”
“Gaelion-chan, do you… know the Dragon King’s weakness?”
“I don’t know!”
She’s no help at all. Well, she only has the fragments that Rival possesses, after all.
“More! I need more power! Power great enough to destroy the world, to wipe out a world without Takt—”
Just as the dragon roared, all its heads began thrashing about in agony. What on earth happened?
“Don’t kill them!? Protect the world!? Don’t even think such nonsense! I must kill them—guh, guaaaaah!”
“W-what on earth is going on!?”
“The Dragon King is taking over his mind!”
“Huh?”
“Even a Dragon Emperor can’t resist if he hasn’t fused his will with his Dragon King. The Dragon King will completely take control of that Dragon Emperor in no time!”
“No way!”
My Father is looking at the enemy with sympathy. That’s Takt’s dragon, after all. There’s no need for sympathy.
“Separate that power right now! Otherwise, he’ll go berserk!”
“I shall dominate my Dragon King—and slaughter every last one of you—Guaaaaaaaah—”
And just like that, after the dragon let out a death-like roar, the color of its eyes completely changed. From eyes that once held intelligence to those of a pure beast.
“I’ll finish it off in a flash!”
“Y-yeah. That thing is…”
“It has no self-awareness left. It’s too late.”

I fired the Aiming Lancer X at all its heads, then obliterated it with the Brionac X. However, the dismembered corpse of the dragon, now transformed into a Dragon King, turned into rain clouds and blended in with the clouds in the sky.
“I’m not done yet! Liberation Firestorm X!”

Focusing my mind, I cast Magic to blow away the clouds above. A storm of flames reached out toward the rain clouds, tearing through them as it engulfed them. Eventually, I dispersed all the rain clouds.

It feels like the Magic landed perfectly. In fact, the number “10” on the hourglass is flashing. Isn’t the Dragon King weaker than I thought? No—it’s just that through repeated enhancements, I’ve grown strong enough to defeat it easily. Just as I was thinking that, the scattered rain clouds reformed.
Then, the Dragon King reappeared. Its form has completely changed—it’s now a dragon worthy of the name. Its roar is so high-pitched that to us, it sounds like nothing but an ultrasonic wave.
“Brionac X!”
Without pause, I unleashed Skills at the Dragon King.

If I could blow that massive Dragon King’s head off with this, victory would be within reach. However, the moment I blew its head off, the Dragon King transformed back into a raincloud. What’s more, the remaining clouds—which I thought I’d blown away—began to swarm around us.

Then, as if launching a counterattack, it transformed into a massive tornado, trying to blow us away. We can weather the acid rain with Father’s Shooting Star Shield, but this is a truly unsettling opponent—one that feels almost insubstantial.
However, the tornado sweeps everything in its path away. Is this… the Phoenix’s self-destruct attack?
“Motoyasu, do you know how to defeat the Dragon King?”
“I’ve never actually fought one. I know the strategies from the game, but based on what we’ve seen so far, this is probably different from the game.”

Both the Spirit Tortoise and the Phoenix were different. I’m sure there must be some specific conditions we need to meet to defeat it. It was also my first time seeing the Hydra form that Takt’s dragon transformed into. Is that something like the Yamata no Orochi from mythology? At first, it had nine heads.
“Hurry! Get the citizens to evacuate!”

The queen is standing in front of the gate, directing the evacuation. We’re launching attacks against the Dragon King, which is spewing strong acid through the gaps in the clouds toward the castle town.
Smoke is billowing throughout the castle town from the acid. The roofs of the buildings we’re using as footholds are turning black and charring. In some places, buildings are melting away.

So far, the most effective attack has been Liberation Firestorm. I’ve cast it several times to blow the Dragon King’s clouds away, but it only buys us a little time. Father is shifting his focus to rescue operations. Right now, residents throughout the castle town—including Melromarc Castle—are fleeing for their lives.
“How the hell are we supposed to defeat a thing like that!? Wait, seeing as the hourglass was flashing, does that mean we’ve already defeated it once? Ugh… I have no idea what’s going on!”
“I felt a definite impact. Though the clouds that dispersed immediately regenerated.”
“Is it like the Spirit Tortoise—no grace period?”
“It was one of the Four Spirits, the strongest in the game. It’s not impossible.”
“So does that mean we have to defeat the Dragon King last? Ugh… It’s tough enough just dealing with the Spirit Tortoise and the Phoenix!”
It looks like it’s going to be a tough battle. Since my father is evacuating civilians and needs time to devise a strategy, it’d be best if I fought the Dragon King.
“I’ll cast a different spell.”

Since casting “Firestorm” can blow away the rain clouds, we can handle the evacuation quickly. So, even though it’ll get a bit hot, we should use a spell that dispels the persistent rain clouds to protect the citizens of Melromarc who are evacuating.
“Liberation Prominence X!”
I’ll summon a sun-like blaze in the sky to keep the rain clouds at bay. The rain clouds are clearing away under the blinding sunlight.
“Good thinking! Everyone! Hurry and evacuate!”
Just then, the Dragon King came crashing down.
The ultrasonic noise is deafening. Oh? The lower-level characters are collapsing, bleeding from their ears. Does even its roar deal damage? As for its size… I’d estimate it’s over 30 meters.
“I’ll fight and buy some time. Father should prioritize evacuating the civilians.”
“Got it! Motoyasu-kun, I’ll be right back!”
With that, my Father took off running to finish the evacuation as quickly as possible. He’s rushing to minimize the damage as much as he can.
“I’ll fight too!”
“Yuki-chan and the others, prioritize providing support.”
I can’t very well let Filolial-sama and the others do anything dangerous. Yuki-chan gave a slight nod and took up a position to cast support magic from the rear.
“Gungnir X! Brionac X!”

She unleashed her Skills one after another at the Dragon King. Hmm? As expected, the spear offers some resistance. This has been true of every enemy we’ve faced so far, but it’s vastly different from those who’ve become so powerful that they offer no resistance at all.

She blasted its head off several times with a thud, but each time, it transformed into water and regenerated instantly. What’s more, if I let my guard down even for a moment, it generates rain clouds. To top it off, it even releases strong acid mist and fog. Finally, it fired a breath attack resembling the lightning bolts emitted by the Spirit Tortoise.

It was a real struggle to keep it from hitting Yuki-chan and the others. I ended up taking a bit of damage myself. Without dodging the Prominence, multiple rain clouds gathered to form the Dragon King. I believe that’s its true form.

Right now, I’m wearing a cloak made of magical flames. This completely nullifies the strong acid rain. I’ve also deployed it to protect Yuki-chan and the others. It’s like my pseudo-Father’s Shooting Star Shield.
Now then, what are the conditions for defeating the Dragon King? Or perhaps we haven’t met them yet?
